description: Reviewed generalized catalog and default-output expectations. Original explicit-input formulas remain frozen in formula-builder-cases.json. legacyGuidance contains only intentional text changes; legacy references and generated formulas are never overridden.

catalog.label: Append Date to Text
catalog.explanation: Appends a date to text from the current row, separated by " - ". When the date is blank, returns the original text.

fields.label: Text column
fields.help: The current-sheet column containing the text to keep before the date.

fields.label: Date column
fields.help: The current-sheet date column to append when it has a value.

catalog.label: Schedule Movement in Weekdays
catalog.explanation: Calculates signed weekday movement between an original date and a revised date. Positive values indicate a later date; negative values indicate an earlier date. Blank input dates return blank.

fields.label: Original date column
fields.help: The original or baseline date on the current sheet.

fields.label: Updated date column
fields.help: The revised date on the current sheet.

catalog.label: Cross-Sheet Two-Criteria Lookup
catalog.explanation: Returns the first source value from another sheet where both source criteria match the current row. Returns blank if the lookup produces an error.

fields.label: Current sheet criteria column 1
fields.help: The first value to match from the current row.

fields.label: Current sheet criteria column 2
fields.help: The second value to match from the current row.

fields.label: Source sheet name
fields.help: The Smartsheet sheet that contains the lookup data.

fields.label: Source return column
fields.help: The source-sheet column that contains the value you want returned.

fields.label: Source criteria column 1
fields.help: The source-sheet column that should match criteria column 1.

fields.label: Source criteria column 2
fields.help: The source-sheet column that should match criteria column 2.

fields.label: Return range reference name
fields.help: The name to use for the cross-sheet return range.

fields.label: Criteria 1 range reference name
fields.help: The name to use for the first cross-sheet criteria range.

fields.label: Criteria 2 range reference name
fields.help: The name to use for the second cross-sheet criteria range.

catalog.label: Checkbox Based on Cross-Sheet Match
catalog.explanation: Checks a box when the current row's configured value appears in a reference range from another sheet.

fields.label: Current sheet match column
fields.help: The value from the current row to search for in another sheet.

fields.label: Source sheet name
fields.help: The sheet containing the source values to match.

fields.label: Source match column
fields.help: The source-sheet column that should contain the current row value.

fields.label: Match range reference name
fields.help: The name to use for the cross-sheet match range.

catalog.label: Cross-Sheet First-Match Lookup
catalog.explanation: Returns the first value from another sheet where the source match column equals the current row's lookup value. Returns blank if the lookup produces an error.

fields.label: Current sheet lookup column
fields.help: The current-sheet column containing the lookup value to match.

fields.label: Source sheet name
fields.help: The sheet containing the return and match columns.

fields.label: Source return column
fields.help: The source-sheet column containing the value to return.

fields.label: Source match column
fields.help: The source-sheet column to compare with the current row's lookup value.

fields.label: Return range reference name
fields.help: The name to use for the cross-sheet return range.

fields.label: Match range reference name
fields.help: The name to use for the cross-sheet match range.

catalog.label: Combine Three Columns into Text
catalog.explanation: Combines three current-row columns in the fixed pattern "Prefix - Middle Final". Returns blank when the prefix is blank.

fields.label: Prefix column
fields.help: The first value in the combined text. If this cell is blank, the output is blank.

fields.label: Middle column
fields.help: The value placed after the prefix and " - " separator.

fields.label: Final column
fields.help: The value placed after the middle value and a single space.

catalog.label: Extract Longest Word (First 6 Words)
catalog.explanation: Returns the longest word among the first six space-separated words in the source text. Ties favor the earliest matching word. Blank source text returns blank.

fields.label: Source text column (first 6 words)
fields.help: The current-sheet text column to inspect. The formula returns the longest of its first six space-separated words, not an abbreviation.

catalog.label: Count Checkbox Values
catalog.explanation: Counts checked, unchecked, or both checkbox states from another sheet.

fields.label: Cross-sheet checkbox reference name
fields.help: The named Smartsheet reference that points to the checkbox column you want to count.

fields.label: Count type
fields.help: Choose whether to count checked boxes, unchecked boxes, or both.

catalog.label: Convert Month Name to Number
catalog.explanation: Converts full English month names to numbers from 1 to 12 for calendar-order sorting. Blank or unrecognized names return blank.

fields.label: Month name column
fields.help: The current-sheet column containing a full English month name, such as January or February.

catalog.label: Schedule Health Indicator
catalog.explanation: Returns Green for completed tasks, Red for overdue tasks or tasks whose start date has passed while their status is not started, and Yellow otherwise. Uses the current row's start date, finish date, and status.

fields.label: Start date column
fields.help: The current-sheet start date column used to flag work that should have started.

fields.label: Finish date column
fields.help: The current-sheet finish date column used to flag overdue work.

fields.label: Status column
fields.help: The current-sheet column that stores the task status.

fields.label: Not started value
fields.help: The status text that means work has not started.

fields.label: Complete value
fields.help: The status text that means the work is complete.

catalog.label: Multi-Line Task Assignment Label
catalog.explanation: Creates a fixed multi-line task assignment label containing a task, location, and up to three assignees. Output labels are "Task Lead:", "Task Second:", and "Task Third:"; the second and third assignee lines are omitted when their cells are blank.

fields.label: Task column
fields.help: The current-sheet column containing the task name.

fields.label: Location column
fields.help: The current-sheet column that stores the location name.

fields.label: Primary assignee column
fields.help: The column for the fixed "Task Lead:" output line.

fields.label: Second assignee column
fields.help: The column for the fixed "Task Second:" output line. The column name is required; a blank cell omits this line.

fields.label: Third assignee column
fields.help: The column for the fixed "Task Third:" output line. The column name is required; a blank cell omits this line.

catalog.label: Date Attribute for Checked Rows
catalog.explanation: For checked rows, returns the year, calendar quarter, or month number from the preferred date, using the fallback date when the preferred date is blank. Unchecked rows return blank.

fields.label: Include row checkbox column
fields.help: The checkbox column identifying rows that should return a date attribute.

fields.label: Fallback date column
fields.help: The date to use when the preferred date cell is blank.

fields.label: Preferred date column
fields.help: The date to use first when its cell has a value.

fields.label: Attribute to return
fields.help: Choose year, calendar quarter (Q1-Q4), or month number.

catalog.label: Single-Criteria Cross-Sheet Lookup
catalog.explanation: Looks up a value from another sheet when the current row has a matching ID, name, or other lookup key.

fields.label: Source return reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference that points to the source value you want returned.

fields.label: Source match reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference that points to the source lookup key or ID column.

fields.label: Current sheet lookup column
fields.help: The current-sheet column that contains the value to match.

catalog.label: Join Matching Values
catalog.explanation: Collects multiple matching values from another sheet and displays them together in one cell.

fields.label: Source values reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference that points to the values you want to return.

fields.label: Source match reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference that points to the source match column.

fields.label: Current sheet lookup column
fields.help: The current-sheet column that contains the value to match.

fields.label: Match output type
fields.help: Choose whether repeated matching values should be kept or removed.

fields.label: Separator
fields.help: Choose how the matching values should be separated in the output cell.

catalog.label: Count Rows Matching Two Criteria
catalog.explanation: Counts rows from another sheet where both configured text criteria match.

fields.label: Criteria range 1 reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference for the first criteria column.

fields.label: Criteria 1 value
fields.help: The first exact text value to count.

fields.label: Criteria range 2 reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference for the second criteria column.

fields.label: Criteria 2 value
fields.help: The second exact text value to count.

catalog.label: Sum Values Matching Two Criteria
catalog.explanation: Sums numeric values from another sheet where both configured text criteria match.

fields.label: Source value reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference that points to the numeric values to sum.

fields.label: Criteria range 1 reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference for the first criteria column.

fields.label: Criteria 1 value
fields.help: The first exact text value to match.

fields.label: Criteria range 2 reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference for the second criteria column.

fields.label: Criteria 2 value
fields.help: The second exact text value to match.

catalog.label: Average Values Matching Two Criteria
catalog.explanation: Averages numeric values from another sheet where both configured text criteria match. Returns blank if the calculation produces an error.

fields.label: Source value reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference that points to the numeric values to average.

fields.label: Criteria range 1 reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference for the first criteria column.

fields.label: Criteria 1 value
fields.help: The first exact text value to match.

fields.label: Criteria range 2 reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference for the second criteria column.

fields.label: Criteria 2 value
fields.help: The second exact text value to match.

catalog.label: Latest or Earliest Matching Date
catalog.explanation: Finds the latest or earliest date related to the current row's lookup value.

fields.label: Source date reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference that points to the source date column.

fields.label: Source match reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference that points to the source match column.

fields.label: Current sheet lookup column
fields.help: The current-sheet column that contains the value to match.

fields.label: Date result type
fields.help: Choose whether to return the newest or oldest matching date.

catalog.label: Count Unique Values Matching Two Criteria
catalog.explanation: Counts distinct values from another sheet where both configured text criteria match, without double-counting repeated values.

fields.label: Source unique value reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference that points to the value to count once.

fields.label: Criteria range 1 reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference for the first criteria column.

fields.label: Criteria 1 value
fields.help: The first exact text value to match.

fields.label: Criteria range 2 reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference for the second criteria column.

fields.label: Criteria 2 value
fields.help: The second exact text value to match.

catalog.label: Parent/Child Rollup Summary
catalog.explanation: Rolls up child-row values into a parent row.

fields.label: Child value column
fields.help: The current-sheet column that contains the child values to summarize.

fields.label: Rollup type
fields.help: Choose how the child values should roll up to the parent row.

catalog.label: Hierarchy Level Helper
catalog.explanation: Identifies how deeply a row is indented in the sheet hierarchy.

fields.label: Level numbering type
fields.help: Choose whether top-level rows should return 0 or 1.

catalog.label: Show Parent Value
catalog.explanation: Pulls the parent row's value into the current row.

fields.label: Parent value column
fields.help: The current-sheet column whose parent value should appear on child rows.

catalog.label: Multi-Select Contains / HAS Check
catalog.explanation: Checks whether a selected value exists in a multi-select dropdown or multi-contact cell.

fields.label: Multi-select column
fields.help: The multi-select dropdown or multi-contact column to check.

fields.label: Value to check for
fields.help: The selectable value that should be found in the cell.

fields.label: Output type
fields.help: Choose the type of result the formula should return.

catalog.label: Text Before / After Delimiter
catalog.explanation: Splits combined text into the portion before or after a selected delimiter.

fields.label: Source text column
fields.help: The current-sheet text column that contains the combined value.

fields.label: Delimiter
fields.help: The delimiter exactly as it appears in the source text.

fields.label: Extract type
fields.help: Choose which side of the delimiter should be returned.

catalog.label: Task Readiness from Open Predecessor Count
catalog.explanation: Returns a task's complete, ready, or blocked status using an existing open-predecessor count. This formula does not calculate predecessor relationships or the count itself.

fields.label: Open predecessor count column
fields.help: The current-sheet column that stores the number of unfinished predecessor tasks.

fields.label: Status column
fields.help: The current-sheet status column.

fields.label: Complete status value
fields.help: The status value that means the task is complete.

fields.label: Ready output value
fields.help: The value to return when open predecessor count is zero.

fields.label: Blocked output value
fields.help: The value to return when the task is not complete and the open predecessor count is not zero.

fields.label: Complete output value
fields.help: The value to return when the status already shows complete.

catalog.label: Nth Highest or Lowest Value
catalog.explanation: Returns one Nth highest or Nth lowest numeric value from a source range, such as the second-highest amount or third-lowest duration. It does not return a list of the top N values.

fields.label: Source value reference
fields.help: The cross-sheet reference that points to the numeric values to rank.

fields.label: Rank number
fields.help: The rank to return. Use 1 for the highest or lowest value.

fields.label: Ranking type
fields.help: Choose whether to rank from the top or bottom of the source values.

expected.explanation: Calculates signed weekday movement between an original date and a revised date. Positive values indicate a later date; negative values indicate an earlier date. Blank input dates return blank.
expected.formula: =IF(OR(ISBLANK([Original Date]@row), ISBLANK([New Date]@row)), "", IF([New Date]@row >= [Original Date]@row, NETWORKDAYS([Original Date]@row, [New Date]@row) - 1, -(NETWORKDAYS([New Date]@row, [Original Date]@row) - 1)))
setupNotes: This formula only uses columns from the current sheet.
instructions: Add this formula to a Text/Number column on the same sheet as the date columns.
Positive values mean New Date is later than Original Date.
Negative values mean the revised date moved earlier. This formula excludes Saturdays and Sundays and does not supply a holiday calendar.

Make sure each reference points to a full column or same-height range on the source sheet.
Paste the formula into the current sheet where you want Result returned.

expected.explanation: Checks a box when the current row's configured value appears in a reference range from another sheet.
setupNotes: Create the named cross-sheet references in Smartsheet before using this formula.
Keep the referenced source ranges aligned so Smartsheet can compare rows correctly.
instructions: Create the cross-sheet reference from Lookup Data.
Select the source column named Related Record ID.
Paste the formula into a Checkbox column on the current sheet.

expected.explanation: Returns the first value from another sheet where the source match column equals the current row's lookup value. Returns blank if the lookup produces an error.
setupNotes: Create the named cross-sheet references in Smartsheet before using this formula.
Keep the referenced source ranges aligned so Smartsheet can compare rows correctly.

Use Result as the return range and Record ID as the match range.
